My vision cleared up once I pressed the button.
随着我按下按钮，视野立刻变得清晰起来。

I feel the sensation of striking a hard floor, but the rattling aches pass before long. Cold water swallows my body in its tides and drags it under.
撞击到坚硬地面的钝痛只掠过了一瞬，我很快就被冰冷的水流包裹着向下沉去。

Soon, the water fills my lungs. I can't breathe.
不久后，随着水充满胸口的感觉，我逐渐开始喘不上来气。

Through my blurred vision, I see rippling water and cresting white foam. Sunshine pours down over the scenery beyond.
我勉强恢复的视野中映出了摇曳的波涛和雪白的泡沫。以及从另一侧洒下的阳光。

It isn't long before the pressure crushing my chest disappears. The water that surrounds me feels like a warm embrace.
不知不觉间，胸口被压迫的感觉消失了，水流温柔地包裹着我的身体。

Thoughts I normally would never entertain spring uncontrollably, flooding my mind.
平常不会去思索的事情此时无法控制地朝我涌来。

I can feel my nerves pulsating.
我全身的神经都在搏动。

I feel as though this head, attached to me but not really mine, is going to be submerged underwater forever.
终于……这个一直在我身上却不属于我的脑袋，似乎要在这片水底永眠了。

Is it comfort that washes over me...? Or is it...
我是……感到安心吗？还是……

<color=#916e46>We extend our warmest welcome to the valued guests of Grand Magasin Sisyphe visiting today.</color>
<color=#916e46>今日也热烈欢迎各位客人光临西西弗百货。</color>

<color=#916e46>Grand Magasin Sisyphe is ever committed to cherishing every experience our customers procure within.</color>
<color=#916e46>西西弗百货，一直致力于珍惜客人们在此可获得的所有经验。</color>

<color=#916e46>To keep abreast of the latest fashions, we actively encourage the wide variety of shops available at the department store to open and close according to trends. Please take care not to lose your way as you explore the establishment.</color>
<color=#916e46>我们西西弗百货，总是根据潮流来推荐各类店铺的开张与闭店。请各位客人注意不要迷路。</color>

<color=#916e46>As always, restrooms on every floor are currently under repair. Please take note of this when planning your visit. We apologize for the inconvenience.</color>
<color=#916e46>一如既往，百货店内所有楼层的卫生间目前都处于维修状态中。由此带来的不便，请您谅解。</color>

<color=#916e46>To prevent hygiene issues, entry to each floor will be limited to customers who have achieved the required Prestige Tier. Please visit our Customer Service Center on the sixth floor for any further queries.</color>
<color=#916e46>为防止污染，目前仅限身份符合的客人可进入各楼层。如有任何疑问，请移步至6F客服中心。</color>

<color=#916e46>Customers are welcome to make physical contact with all Mannequins on display. Conversely, Mannequins are also allowed to make physical contact with all customers. Should you wish to participate, please talk to the sales associate at the relevant shop, who will be delighted to assist you.</color>
<color=#916e46>此外，我们允许自由触碰展出的人台。我们同样允许人台自由触碰各位，如果您咨询店员的话，他们会很乐意为您提供帮助。</color>

<color=#916e46>We ask everyone to do their best to ensure another day of worthwhile consumer experience for our customers. Thank you for choosing Grand Magasin Sisyphe, and enjoy your shopping.</color>
<color=#916e46>那么今天也请大家致力于为客人们提供有价值的购物体验。祝您购物愉快。</color>

What we experienced just now...
方才我们所经受的究竟是……

I just know it's something I never want to go through again... I mean, I've been killed in a variety of different ways on this team, but to be forced to face death when it wasn't even a combat situation... And on top of that, having to feel the sensation of doing it myself is just... a big no. 是我不想再经历第二次的东西。虽然我们确实经历过各种各样的死法，但这可是在非战斗的情况下……而且是凭自己的意志去死的感觉……呃呜。
Can't believe residents in N Corp. pay money to purchase that nasty experience. You couldn't pay me to go through that twice. N公司的人们竟然会花钱体验这些。就算有人拿钱砸我我也不会去的。

To package the very severing of life as amusement, then sell it as a product...
竟然将离世的体验包装成娱乐售卖……

Though conquering boredom is, forsooth, no simple feat, this is... hmm...
虽说克服无趣十分困难……嗯……

It felt more real than I imagined.
它比我想象中要真实得多。

I knew it was all taking place within a machine... Yet in that moment, I truly felt as though... I were witnessing the final moments of my life.
虽然我知道这是在机器中发生的事情……但那一瞬间真的……让我觉得这幅景象就是最后能看到的画面了。

When the noose tightened, I thought my neck was gonna snap...
我的脖子都被勒得快要断掉了……
I'm with Ishy... People actually pay money to put themselves through this? 大家为什么花钱也要体验这种东西呢？

There are those who, with no real purpose in mind, tie themselves to a cord and leap from great heights, or surrender themselves to violent waves to see whether or not they will be swept under.
有些人并没有什么特别的目的，只是想要体验系上绳子从高处落下的感觉，或是任凭身体在激流中漂荡，只为测试自己会不会掉下去。

It is said that people come to feel the sensation of being alive more keenly via experiences that bring them infinitely close to death.
据说在那些逼近死亡的体验之中，反而能感受到自己依旧活着。

... So ya sayin' they do it on purpose?
……所以他们是故意的？

Distasteful.
真让人不爽。

Wait, I've... I've heard this exact conversation before.
我……似乎什么时候听过这段对话。

When... where did I hear this conversation before...? My brain feels like a chaotic scramble of disconnected information—I feel it's going to take a while to get it all in order.
至于是什么时候……我纠缠不清的脑海中怎么也整理不清楚。

<This is... the Fount...>
<这里不是泉吗……>

Wha? The Fount? We're obviously in a—
泉？！你在说什么呢？这里……怎么看都是……

... It's a restroom.
……是卫生间。

Verily, 'tis a privy!
嗯，此乃卫生间。

A place where one's innermost troubles may be emptied.
确实是解忧所。

We went through all that shite in that bloody machine... just to get to a toilet?
不过是……为了去个卫生间，就非要用那台机器搞出这么大动静吗？

It's true Nelly's lies did put us in danger before, but it didn't appear to me that she was trying to harm or deceive us this time around...
虽然耐莉小姐的谎言曾让我们陷入了绝境……但这次感受不到她要那么做的理由或是迹象。

Fau. The machine we triggered... was it some kind of teleporter?
小浮，我们启动的那个东西……是什么空间传送的机器吗？

The verdict would differ depending on our interpretation of the experience, but it is certain that our bodies were not physically sent to this place. That shouldn't be an issue, however, as this is indeed the destination we were bound for, which we have reached successfully.
嗯……虽然这取决于怎么定义，但我们的身体并没有被传送至其他空间。不过这里就是我们的目的地，所以没有问题。

So... where the heck are we? Where do we go to find Meur?
所以……要去哪里才能见到默尔呢？

<What are you talking about? Meursault's right there in his usual spot, by the exit—>
<你们在说什么？默尔索和往常一样在门前面……>

I turned toward the exit point to where Meursault... used to be, and realized that he wasn't there. I looked around the restroom, searching for his whereabouts, but I couldn't see him anywhere.
默尔索不在。卫生间里到处都没有默尔索的身影。
What are you talking about, Dante? The whole reason we're here is to find Meursault, remember? 但丁，你在说什么呢？我们不就是为了找默尔索先生才来这里的吗。

... Oi, the Suicide Vending Machine must've knocked a gear off the Clock or somethin'. They're out of it.
……喂，时钟的状态好像不对劲啊？自杀贩卖机的影响还没过去吗？
what are you guys talking about?! We failed. Doomed to forever—> <我才该问你们在说什么吧？我们失败了，要永远……>

I turned to Faust, someone I could almost always trust to be in the know...
我想浮士德可能会知道些什么，便向她走去……

<Faust!>
<浮士德！>

... Ah. If... if that is the case...
……啊。如果……是这样的话。

... then I'd better speak as little as possible on this matter.
……我最好还是少说几句吧。

... but she simply looked away from me—a clear sign that she wasn't willing to divulge anything.
就像在说“我不会继续回答了”一般，浮士德背过了脸。

Clock.
时钟。

<Am I the only one who remembers this? We already... we were there for the end of the Grand Magasin... We...>
<为什么谁也不记得了？我们已经……将百货店的结局给……>
Déjà vu... I've been here before. Witnessed something before returning... or being rewound, I suppose. 这种既视感……我肯定是见过什么才回归的。不，准确来说是“被覆盖了”吧。

So calm down, C.H.
所以冷静点，钟·头。

Arayashiki vibrates, letting out a light hum as though in agreement.
阿赖耶识也像是同意一般嗡嗡震动起来。

... Hang on, hang on. I ain't so sure if they're okay to move on. Even that fire on their noggin feels a bit hotter, I think...
……这家伙真的还好吗？总感觉火也变烫了点……

Who knows. Must be M.P. or something.
谁知道呢。嘛……记·错之类的吧。

"Must be memory poisoning or something"...? Like food poisoning? What does that even...
记忆错误之类的吧……？那是什么意……

Ohh, maybe that's why Dante hallucinated Meursault by the exit. That explains the random stuff they said about the Grand Magasin—they were probably bombarded by Meur's memories on the way here!
进来的时候，你是不是看到了许多默尔的记忆？所以才会说什么默尔索在门前、百货店之类的东西吧。

Maybe that's what happened. Whenever someone's "turn" comes, Dante tends to get a chance to peek into their memories.
也许就是这样呢。一直都是轮到谁，经理阁下就能窥见谁的记忆。

Ryōshū looked around the room, discomfort visible in her knitted brows.
良秀就像是发现了什么一般，眉头深深皱起，环视起了四周。

Maybe Ryōshū actually remembers something about the Grand Magasin from before...? No, I don't think that's what's happening. But I can't shake this nagging feeling that I'm missing something to be making any definite guesses at this moment.
大概是良秀也有之前在百货店里的记忆吧？我不知道……但要去确信这件事的话，我心中总有些耿耿于怀的事情。

Has all of that been a figment of my imagination, then? Or a dream?
还是说那一切都是幻觉或者梦境吗？

<That doesn't seem plausible...>
<不可能是那样……>

If it really were just an illusion or a dream, Faust wouldn't have reacted as though she knew something. Besides, everything we went through at the Grand Magasin was vivid enough to dispel any notion of dismissing it as a product of momentary delusion—at least for me.
如果是幻觉或者梦境的话……浮士德是不会看上去像是知道些什么的，更重要的是，在百货店里经验的事情至今都栩栩如生。

For now... I say that you must rest upon this wall awhile and recover. At present, naught appears to pose a direct threat.
暂且……倚靠墙壁休憩一会吧。如今，此处……似乎并没有什么威胁。

Never should've thrown ourselves so blindly into that machine of dubious function...
果然不该相信那个可疑的机器的……

Perhaps we can question that woman there and gather some information while the Executive Manager takes their much-needed rest.
在执行经理休息期间……我们也能向那个人打听一下在意的事情吧。

She looks similar... to Demian...
她和德米安……长得好像……

Identify yourself. What do you know about this place?
你是谁？关于这里你知道多少？

... This place...
……这里是……

The woman, with a benevolent smile gracing her lips, is watching us serenely.
一位面带慈爱微笑的女性依然注视着我们。

I'd seen her before, too.
而且我也见过那位女性。

... It is where everything that is washed away comes to rest. The "Fount"...
一切都被濯洗而去，顺流所抵达的场所……泉……

The Fount?! Hey, that's what Dante called this place earlier—
泉？！确实是刚刚但丁说的……

Shh.
嘘。

Outis paused, waiting for Rodya and Ryōshū's brief altercation to end, then continued her query toward the mysterious woman.
奥提斯盯了一会儿打断了罗佳话语的良秀，再次看向那位充满谜团的女性，开口问道。

... That's not what we asked.
……我们问的不是这种问题。

Are you affiliated with this establishment? Can't deny there is something familiar about you.
你是这里的相关人员吗？虽然我并不能否认你的长相有些眼熟……

... All things appear... as one believes them to be.
……一切都只是……看上去如自己相信那般罢了。

Well, at least she doesn't seem hostile to us...
至少她对我们没有敌意……不过……

Do you happen to know what we're... supposed to do here...? Could you tell us if you do?
难道您恰好知道吗？我们在这里……该做些什么好……

... The woman in blue doesn't seem to have anything more to say. She just continues to regard us in silence with that same, benevolent smile.
可能是话已经说完了，她只是沉默地微笑着。而那副微笑依旧满是慈爱。

Would it still be safe if we just... left through that door over there?
我们，那个……就这么出去可以吗？

There was one very clear-cut way of finding out whether this had all been just a product of my imagination or not, and I was ready to confirm it. Once we leave through that exit, we'll first be greeted by a veritable waterfall of corpses. Then, as we panic at the sudden turn of events, Kromer's sister will emerge from somewhere and chat us up with her feigned affability.
如果这一切不是我的错觉的话……出去的时候会有尸体掉下来，然后克罗默的姐姐会向我们搭话。

If anything, my memory of the previous experience remains. I remember every detail.
……我记得自己所经验过的事情。

<First things first... Let's get a move on and see what's outside.>
<总之……先出去吧。>
